notes: pendulum.timezone(name) in prepare; DateTime.fromtimestamp(t, tz=zone), strftime and utcoffset() in seconds. Reads the tzdata package. Not pendulum.from_timestamp: on PyPy, where pendulum runs pure Python, it converts via UTC and returns an hour-off wall-clock time just before a transition (2012-03-11T00:59:59 instead of 01:59:59 in New York); DateTime.fromtimestamp is right on both runtimes.
